ask_level.title: How much Claude asks
ask_level.description: normal: Claude asks before a heavy process nobody asked for, when a request can be read two ways, and before retrying a failed store upload. less: it does not ask in those cases; it skips the heavy check and says so, picks the sensible reading, retries a diagnosed upload, and saves real product choices for one question. Needs the nextc rules installed (setup-rules.sh).
